summary: Accenture Capital Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $5 billion debt offering comprising floating rate notes due 2029 and fixed-rate senior notes due 2029-2036, fully guaranteed by Accenture plc. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a debt takedown under an existing shelf registration—not a special situation. Terms include $300M floating rate notes at SOFR+70bps and $1B-$1.5B tranches at fixed coupons of 4.750%-5.600%. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The filing contains no event-driven or structural change such as a merger, buyout, activist campaign, or restructuring.
